recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only reintroduce broad STU/trial-use labels in normative CapabilityStatement if FMG/FHIR-I makes a new explicit R6+ policy decision, likely via FHIR-54783 or successor work.
issue_request: FHIR-14444 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested selected CapabilityStatement.rest.resource fields be trial-use, implementation guidance for trial-use material in CapabilityStatement, and documentation of a parameter that indicates the kind of /metadata response.
initial_application: The issue was applied in migrated svn revision 14469, now git commit 81544e1ec1a3d0e678fc0266a0f1510d1d9a44a1, which added /metadata{?mode=[mode]}, Mixed Normative Content guidance, and trial-use markers in the old CapabilityStatement spreadsheet source.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in the current build and is normative since 4.0.0. The /metadata mode parameter remains in current source/http.html. Later R6 cleanup commits 5c20769cc74459a8c1057d2747418dc4340f4244 and 7466cfc63cd0b162497a42c80a67480eed86c75a removed the broad element-level trial-use markers and Mixed Normative Content note; FMG/FHIR-54783 context supports handling STU-in-normative-resource policy as future work rather than an R6 core source fix.
reconciliation: No source change was made because reintroducing the old FHIR-14444 mixed trial-use labels would undo later R6 source history and conflict with the current policy path. The operational /metadata mode parameter part of the issue is still present.

related_jiras.note: Direct Jira comment says it drew the same conclusion for CapabilityStatement.messaging and CapabilityStatement.document, but this seed audit was limited to FHIR-14444.
Later CapabilityStatement maturity work records the resource-level FMM 5/normative status that frames current source interpretation.
Terminology capabilities used the /metadata mode mechanism introduced by FHIR-14444.
Its audit records later R6 removal of broad trial-use element markers from normative resources and the supporting FMG/FHIR-54783 policy context.
Deferred future work for a mechanism to support STU elements in normative artifacts, supporting no current R6 core edit for this seed.
